question: What verbal and ritual faults toward others and mantra must be avoided?
premises: Criticism of all is named as a fault
Misuse or making of mantra is named as a fault
inference: One must avoid criticizing all and committing faults regarding mantra.
uncertainties: mantra+kūryāt is obscure; may mean making mantra into an object of fault or improper mantra-making
plain_english: O Great Lady, one must avoid criticizing everyone and committing faults with mantra.
